posts.zh:
dsh-voice-call 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e021943d26c73c0f09b4.html
posts.en:
dsh-voice-call is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e021943d26c73c0f09b4.html
